justification: The sentence check counted only text ending '.?!', so list lead-ins ending ':' that the reader dropped while keeping their items were never asked for (KRG 14B bushfire and Blue Gum lead-ins p33, CoS s2 'Development in Botany Road precinct is to:'). It now splits after a colon when a list item follows and counts a 5+ word lead-in. Offline on the saved 14B read both p33 lead-ins are flagged.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: lead-ins are not counted or a colon inside a sentence splits it
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Turning lead-in counting off fails the lead-in test; restored, all pass.

real_layer_exempt.scripts/ai_extractor.py: offline on the saved KRG 14B review read: both p33 lead-ins flagged

pre_impl.existing_data: held chapters' review rows lack the intro/scope sentences printed on the PDF pages
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: page coverage judges a page by most of its rule lines, so an intro paragraph can be lost on a passed page
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: extends the reader after _reread_skipped_pages; reuses page_coverage.running_lines and doubled_text

functions.name: page_sentences
functions.input: one page of printed text, de-doubled and without running headers
functions.output: its full sentences and list lead-ins as lower-case word lists
functions.if_none: an empty list, so nothing on that page is asked for

values.read_at: shortest list lead-in counted as a sentence

break_it.scenario: a colon inside an ordinary sentence ('is: 5 metres')
break_it.what_happens: the sentence is not split there
break_it.how: split after ':' only before an item label or a number followed by a capitalised word

break_it.scenario: a list lead-in dropped while its items were copied
break_it.what_happens: it is named to the model and re-read

break_it.scenario: a short label ending in a colon such as 'Objectives:'
break_it.what_happens: it is not counted as a lead-in

post_merge.manual_verify: review re-reads of KRG 14G, 14I and Campbelltown Part 4 show 0 lost council sentences in the loss check
